title: No-GPS navigation
lead: Plan with the map before leaving, travel without GPS, then rebuild the route from memory.
pendingEmpty: No routes in progress. Pick a real trip from this week.
doneEmpty: Your routes and how well you recalled them will show up here.
recallScoreAria: You recalled {{pct}}% of the landmarks in order
planLead: Do it while looking at a map (paper or your map app), before leaving. Then put the map away.
landmarksHelp: Write down 3 to 6 landmarks in the order you'll see them: a park, a gas station, where you turn. They keep you from getting lost.
planned: Plan saved. Now do the route without GPS.
flyNoPeek: Don't look at the landmarks you wrote: you'll rebuild them from memory next.

gps.no: Not at all, I found my way
gps.yes: I followed it for much of the way

gotLost: I got lost at some point
gotLostHint: Getting lost and reorienting is practice too.
recallLead: Without looking at the plan. Write the landmarks in order, draw a sketch, or both.
sketchHelp: Draw the route with your finger: start, turns and landmarks. It doesn't need to be pretty.
needOne: Write at least one landmark to compare.
resultLead: You recalled {{pct}}% of the landmarks in the right order.
